name: EndoGaussian Optimization
definition: The optimization framework minimizes the difference between rendered and actual results using rendering constraints and enforces spatiotemporal smoothness using total variation (TV) losses.
summary: EndoGaussian Optimization is a training procedure for dynamic endoscopic reconstruction using 3D Gaussians, distinguished by binocular and monocular depth constraints and spatiotemporal regularization to handle non-rigid tissue deformation and tool occlusion.
